# mimecast_dmarc_definition (Resource)

Manage the DMARC definition for a delegated DMARC Analyzer domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_definition" "example" {
  domain_id        = mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain.example.id
  policy_preset_id = mimecast_dmarc_policy_preset.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Delegated managed-domain ID.

### Optional

- `policy_preset_id` (String) Policy-preset ID used to create the definition. Required on create; may be omitted when importing because Mimecast does not return it.

### Read-Only

- `dkim_alignment` (String) DKIM alignment mode.
- `failure_report_format` (String) Failure report format.
- `failure_reporting_options` (String) Failure reporting options.
- `id` (String) DMARC definition ID, equal to the delegated domain ID.
- `percentage` (Number) Policy application percentage.
- `policy` (String) DMARC policy.
- `record_host` (String) DMARC redirect record host.
- `record_name` (String) DMARC redirect record name.
- `record_published` (Boolean) Whether the redirect record is published.
- `record_ttl` (Number) DMARC redirect record TTL when supplied by Mimecast.
- `record_type` (String) DMARC redirect record type.
- `record_value` (String) DMARC redirect record value.
- `report_interval` (Number) Aggregate-report interval.
- `rua_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Aggregate-report recipients.
- `ruf_addresses` (Set of String, Sensitive) Forensic-report recipients.
- `spf_alignment` (String) SPF alignment mode.
- `subdomain_policy` (String) DMARC subdomain policy.
- `version` (String) DMARC version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_definition.example delegated-domain-id
```
